goals: Implements the 307 reviewed trade decisions and removes dynamic favorite-food buybacks from new and saved villagers.
scope: Resolves 68 Matcha pools and 280 eligible offers, preserves the approved economy, filters the 42 food writers, and cleans their persisted offers on entity load.
The owner decision table and effective matrix are recorded under tools/.

exclusions: Accepted Matcha source data, originals, unchanged Matcha trade resources, unrelated datapacks, the user's design spreadsheet, and the protected gameplay instance.

dependencies.reason: Targeted villager trade loading and registry baseline.
Capability for the reviewed generation of Matcha trade registries.
